test_container_alert.what: a down:video-worker warning (opened 14:19 KST, announced as a warning, closed 14:36) while the real video-worker was running
test_container_alert.cause: the test container jobcheck-r12 ran the release image quant-company-video:44e24f4, which carries the compose labels com.docker.compose.project=quant-company and com.docker.compose.service=video-worker. The ops probe lists containers by the project label, so once the test exited (14:17) it read as a stopped video-worker.
test_container_alert.fix: the test container was removed at 14:35 after its log was saved under video-fargate-test/jobcheck-r12/run.log, and the incident closed at 14:36; run_jobcheck.sh now starts test containers with --label com.docker.compose.project=video-fargate-test. The render_required notice closed at 14:34 once the status was up_to_date.
